made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/estantes-sheet-make.js, from estantes-set.html (window.ESTANTES.CD) and the design of Los estantes. A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX, OY = H / 2 + originY. A box is the screen bounding box of its 8 projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the floor; z .3: the top of the frog's crate; z 1.46: a rung) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing (a 56-row canvas whose lowest row is empty: the lowest drawn row is 54); the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (so row 25 of the canvas is on sy, as juego.js frogBox: his shadow line q.y + 25); Canelo mkPerro (30 x 22): column 13 (the scenes draw it at -13), its lowest drawn row on sy - 1; a small thing standing (can, bottle, box, crate, net): its bottom middle on the point; a thing lying on the floor (a bottle box seen from above) and the drawing on the wall: its middle on the point
rules.view: a view has a zoom (here 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture) and x0 = clamp(round(sx - 98), 0, 44), sx the projection of its world point. Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
rules.rungs: the ladder has seven rungs at z = LTOP * r / 8 (colmado-dentro.js), LTOP = ESCALERA_ALTO z / .75 = 2.92: 0.365, 0.73, 1.095, 1.46, 1.825, 2.19, 2.555. pepe.escalera is on the fourth, the one nearest z 1.3

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3), so the table hides the legs of don Pepe behind it and nothing behind a character hides him.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The upright plane through the feet, as El balcón's front and El mostrador's; the same test for people, the dog, the goods on the shelves and the things on the table
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias

after.pepe.escalera: don Pepe on the ladder is drawn after the ladder: the pixels of the set's part escalera (the ladder) do not hide him (the depth test is skipped on them); every other set pixel still does

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the floor (z 0)
shadows.off_floor: a character off the floor (don Pepe on the ladder, the frog on his crate) casts none: the spot's z is not 0 (as the frog on El mostrador's counter)
